request: Learn from the supplied art styles and make four versions of Gold Gear Token with Poro as the main character.
references: Screenshot 2026-10-06 at 10.27.40 AM.png: textured gouache floral Poro Gold token
Screenshot 2026-10-06 at 10.29.59 AM.png: luminous winter fantasy illustration with gold geometric framing

variants.name: Flower Meadow
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished alternate-art Gold Gear Token trading card, portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, front view with straight parallel sides; illustration and designed typography fill the canvas edge to edge. Produce exactly one card, not a collage or a photographed mockup.
Primary subject: one large charming Poro from League of Legends, the unmistakable round white fluffy creature with two small curved brown ram horns, stubby little paws, dark beady eyes, and a big playful pink tongue. It is the clear main character.
Art direction learned from two supplied references: textured gouache storybook rendering, painterly dabs and simplified expressive shape language, strong warm-cream Poro silhouette against dense ornament; combine where appropriate with the second reference's luminous winter fantasy illustration, sparkling ice-blue light, elegant delicate geometric gold card frame and dynamic curved motion. Create original composition.
Card layout: artwork occupies the upper 80%; a simple translucent cream or deep navy text panel near the bottom with excellent contrast. Above the panel the small category text is exactly "TOKEN GEAR". In the panel a large title is exactly "GOLD". Beneath it one clearly typeset ability line reads "Kill this," then a drawn black exhaust icon (rounded base with looping downward arrow), then ": REACTION — Add" then a drawn angular resource-rune icon. These are icons, not bracketed explanatory words. REACTION is bold italic with a pale mint highlight. Keep all text and the outer frame safely inside the edges, sharply legible. No other wording.
Constraints: no human champion, no costume hiding the Poro, no champion cost or power numbers, no copied artist signatures, no publisher logos, no copyright text, no watermark, no video play overlay, no stack of cards.
Scene: a delighted Poro nestled in a lush meadow of hundreds of loosely brushed yellow and golden buttercups, olive and deep forest-green foliage. It gleefully hugs one oversized shiny gold coin with a tiny cog-like engraving. A few small gold glints rise among the floating petals. Poro centered, mouth joyfully open, dark brown hand-drawn contours, cream fur with warm brush textures. Style: flatter, playful textured gouache, spontaneous uneven organic contours and dense overlapping floral shapes like a handmade picture book. Palette: butter yellow, marigold, olive, forest green, warm ivory, pink. Soft sunlight. Thin rounded ivory inset card outline, translucent warm cream bottom panel, dark brown lettering. Make this expressive floral concept distinctly different from winter, workshop, and night concepts.
